findings.title: No primary data on corporate client demand
findings.description: The decision relies on secondary references to NodBox (c544, c546, c568) without any direct interviews or surveys of Mumbai corporate HR or procurement teams.
findings.why_it_matters: Without primary demand data, the pilot’s 300‑order goal is speculative.
findings.recommended_action: Run a pilot questionnaire or focus groups with at least 20 corporate accounts.
findings.basis: LLM auditor, citations checked against the run

findings.title: 12 struck and 10 partial of 36 cited statements
findings.description: The entailment verifier found many report or trial statements not fully supported by their quotes.
findings.why_it_matters: Unsupported statements inflate confidence in the conclusion.
findings.recommended_action: Rewrite or drop the struck statements.

findings.title: Market size cited as proof of revenue potential
findings.description: The report uses the overall cloud kitchen market valuation (c921, c262, c734) to infer that a single office‑lunch cloud kitchen can achieve the required 300 daily orders, conflating market size with unit‑level revenue potential.
findings.why_it_matters: Over‑estimating revenue leads to an unjustified go‑ahead decision and may cause cash‑flow shortfalls.
findings.recommended_action: Model unit‑level revenue using comparable pilots rather than global market totals.
findings.basis: LLM auditor, citations checked against the run

findings.title: Regulatory timeline not quantified
findings.description: Regulatory complexity is noted (c135) but the analysis lacks concrete timelines or probability estimates for obtaining multiple brand licences.
findings.why_it_matters: Delays could push the launch beyond the 3‑month pilot window, invalidating the decision criteria.
findings.recommended_action: Map the licensing process with municipal authorities and build a realistic schedule.
findings.basis: LLM auditor, citations checked against the run

findings.title: Ingredient price volatility impact not fully quantified
findings.description: While ingredient cost volatility is mentioned (c137), the analysis does not model its effect on the INR 120 price ceiling or contribution margins (c151).
findings.why_it_matters: Margin compression could make the business model unsustainable at the required price point.
findings.recommended_action: Create sensitivity scenarios for ingredient price swings and test profitability at target pricing.
findings.basis: LLM auditor, citations checked against the run

findings.title: 6 cited claim(s) are stale for their kind
findings.description: Claims the conclusion relies on are old relative to how fast their kind of fact changes (prices, competitors).
findings.why_it_matters: Stale figures can reverse the decision if the market moved.
findings.recommended_action: Re-check these figures against current sources.

findings.title: 36% of cited evidence comes from one domain (imarcgroup.com)
findings.description: The conclusion leans on a single publisher.
findings.why_it_matters: One publisher's error or bias propagates to the verdict.
findings.recommended_action: Find independent publishers for the same facts.

findings.title: 1 challenged claim(s) were contradicted by independent sources
findings.description: c664: independent source contradicts the claim (100%)
findings.why_it_matters: Contradicted claims were down-weighted but still shape the narrative.
findings.recommended_action: Resolve each contradiction with a primary source.

findings.title: 3 numeric conflict(s) between sources are unresolved
findings.recommended_action: Find which figure is current and from whom.

findings.title: 10 statistic(s) are cited without a sample size or measurer
findings.description: Percentages and figures appear without who measured them or on how many.
findings.why_it_matters: Significance cannot be judged; small samples mislead.
findings.recommended_action: Find the underlying study or mark the figure as unverified.

findings.title: Hypothesis h4 rests on 1 independent evidence cluster(s)
findings.description: Regulatory approvals for operating a cloud kitchen in Mumbai (food license, fire safety, waste disposal) can be obtained within 4 weeks.
findings.why_it_matters: Its probability is mostly the starting assumption.

findings.title: Assuming interest equals purchase intent
findings.description: Evidence of interest in convenient, nutritious meals (c514, c489) is treated as if it directly translates into paid corporate orders, ignoring the purchase decision funnel.
findings.why_it_matters: Interest does not guarantee subscription uptake; the pilot may fall short of the 300‑order target.
findings.recommended_action: Conduct a willingness‑to‑pay survey with target corporate clients.
findings.basis: LLM auditor, citations checked against the run

findings.title: In‑house cafeteria or existing vendor competition
findings.description: The report does not consider that many Mumbai offices already have cafeterias or existing contracts with vendors, which could satisfy the same need and limit external subscription uptake.
findings.why_it_matters: An alternative supply source could explain low adoption despite expressed interest.
findings.recommended_action: Assess the penetration of internal food services and existing vendor contracts in target office clusters.
findings.basis: LLM auditor, citations checked against the run
